newsitem.title: USA: Ashland Coal, Arch Mineral to merge.
newsitem.headline: Ashland Coal, Arch Mineral to merge.

text.p: Ashland Coal Inc and Arch Mineral Corp said their boards approved an agreement in principle to combine the two companies.
The exchange ratio to be used would give Arch Mineral shareholders control of the new company with 52 percent. Ashland Coal holders would get 48 percent of the new company.
The companies said no further details would be made public at this time. It said the deal continues to be negotiated.

In October, Ashland Coal said it planned to resume merger talks with St. Louis-based Arch Mineral, which markets and transports bituminous coal in the domestic and export steam and metallurgical coal markets.
Both companies are partially owned by Ashland Inc, which holds about 56 percent of Ashand Coal and about 50 percent of Arch Mineral.
Ashland Coal shares closed at 27-5/8 on Friday.
